name: Plaza at Rockwall
summary: The Plaza at Rockwall is a well-established community shopping center featuring big-box retailers, chain fashion stores, restaurants, and essential services along the I-30 corridor. With over 2,400 positive reviews and a 4.4-star rating, it serves as a convenient one-stop destination for Rockwall residents and Dallas-Fort Worth commuters.
demographics: The Plaza at Rockwall attracts a diverse mix of families and professionals from the rapidly growing Rockwall area, which has experienced significant population growth as a desirable Dallas-Fort Worth suburb. The primary trade area consists of middle to upper-middle income households with median household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $110,000, drawn by the area's highly-rated schools and lakefront lifestyle. Shoppers tend to be convenience-focused families seeking everyday necessities, services, and casual dining options in a convenient location along the I-30 corridor. The center serves both local residents making frequent trips for groceries and services, as well as commuters traveling between Rockwall and the greater Dallas metroplex.
description: The Plaza at Rockwall stands as a premier shopping destination along the I-30 corridor in Rockwall, Texas, serving the rapidly expanding eastern Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. This open-air community center has established itself as the go-to location for residents seeking a comprehensive mix of shopping, dining, and essential services all in one convenient location. The center features familiar big-box retailers and popular chain fashion stores that cater to the everyday needs of local families and professionals. With its strategic position at 995 Interstate 30 Frontage Road, the plaza benefits from excellent visibility and accessibility for both Rockwall residents and commuters traveling through the area. The shopping center has earned a strong reputation in the community, reflected in its impressive 4.4-star rating from over 2,400 reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction with its tenant mix and overall shopping experience. Operating with extended hours to accommodate busy schedules, The Plaza at Rockwall continues to serve as a vital retail hub for this thriving lakeside community.
